command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
echo LOG_READ_START; cat /proc/uptime
echo FILTERED_VLOG_75260_75264
/usr/bin/vlogutil -v kerneltime -s --start-from=75260 --end-to=75264 | awk '/ERR DET Status|GetErrDetStatus|ERR DET Status Debug|RT Protect/ {n++; if(n<=32) print} END {print "FILTER_MATCH_COUNT",n+0}'
echo LOG_READ_END; cat /proc/uptime
echo COMPLETE
